tolerance.set_from: CPU calibration 0.019346 A (worst asserted sample) + 0.010654 A margin, which exceeds the native A-vs-B floor 0.0059 A for this case; kept below the panel's 0.05 A coordinate gate so the 0.122 A run the panel failed would still fail here

entries.notes: Sample 1 is excluded because the port cannot reproduce it: two GPU port runs of this same tape land 0.109 A apart at sample 1 (port-A-vs-port-B.json) while the other four agree to 0.019-0.023 A, and native-vs-port is 0.122 A there against 0.013-0.019 A elsewhere. The native side alone does not show it (native-A-vs-native-B 0.0052 A at sample 1), so it is a port-side basin edge, not a native one. This CPU run measures 0.074618 A at sample 1 against 0.0147-0.0193 A at the other four; asserting on it would assert on the sampler's own scatter. Reproducibility: three separate CPU processes replayed this tape to the same six decimals (0.016604 / 0.074618 / 0.019346 / 0.014694 / 0.018261 A), so the run-to-run floor on CPU is zero and the whole detection margin is the 0.010654 A between the calibration and the tolerance. Measured detection floor: flipping one bit of the tape (msa_column_keep[0,0], the tripwire test) moves the asserted samples to 0.029-0.057 A and fails; adding 1.0 to one element of diffusion_initial_normal moves its sample 0.0166 -> 0.0262 A and passes, and flipping one lm_dropout_masks bit reaches 0.0244 A and passes -- so this test detects coordinate movement above ~0.011 A on the worst asserted sample, well below the panel's 0.05 A gate and the 0.122 A residual it failed. capture.provenance names metadata.json: this capture writes its provenance there, it has no provenance.json. No slicing: bench/esmfold2_tape.py pins SAMPLES = 5 (:31) and validate_diffusion_tape checks batch == 1 * 5, so the tape is replayed whole. upstream_lm.npz is the native ESM-C output injected as lm_hidden_states, which is what keeps the 25.4 GB language model out of a CPU run; upstream_confidence.npz (14 MB) is not fetched because this tier compares coordinates. gpu_residual_angstrom is recorded for context only and is not comparable to the CPU number: port-A ran its own JAX language model (lm_arm jax_independent_lm), this fixture injects the native one, so the LM difference is absent here. Layer certified: the shared core (trunk, sampler, atom decoder) -- features.npz is the native feature dictionary already built, so neither featurizer is exercised. wall_seconds is the replay test's pytest call duration; the replay itself measured 36.7-55.9 s depending on host load, and the whole module (three tests, two replays) 56.4 s.
